svg.title: Wiring schematic
svg.desc: Schematic with a 5 V logic domain (Arduino, TM1637, START button, relay module K1) and a separate 12 V horn domain (fuse F1, switch S1, automotive relay K2 with flyback diode D1, compressor). Only the dry contact of K1 crosses between them.
svg.text: The 5 V logic and the 12 V horn circuit share no connection. Only the dry contact of relay module K1 crosses the isolation line.
The Arduino feeds only the coil of relay module K1.
Every +5V flag and every ground symbol is the same net.
Compressor current flows only through F1, S1, K2 and their wiring.
A small compressor within the contact rating of the module can be
switched by K1 directly (option A, see docs/hardware.md).
